prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1071; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text:
The collision occurred in a parking lot in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 reported neck and lower back strain and was seated in the driver's position of the vehicle when I arrived. The Passenger's account and my own observations confirm that Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 2 was backing out of a space and struck the rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle at low speed.

Damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle is largely consistent with the impact described by both drivers. A few older scratches are visible on the bumper, and these may predate this collision. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the location and general extent of the contact, but no independent witnesses were identified. The reported injuries appear consistent with the type and force of this collision.

Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene. Both drivers were advised of their reporting obligations, and the Passenger declined medical assistance at the scene.
